headline: Liberia Reports 5.1% Economic Growth in 2025 Driven by Mining Sector
summary: Liberia's economy expanded by 5.1% in 2025, largely supported by a 17% increase in mining. However, the World Bank noted that job creation must accelerate to effectively reduce poverty.
